evidence.observation: The speaker describes pricing for end-user support in relation to users, environment, and hours.
evidence.quote: Pricing for end-user support varies with the number of end-users supported, the nature of the environment, and the number of hours for which you'd like support.

evidence.observation: A slide titled “Pricing & Packaging” lists Enterprise Premium starting at $40k, Enterprise Basic starting at $20k, and pricing descriptions for customization, administration, and end-user support.
A slide titled “Customization Support” describes developer-level assistance and lists question-and-answer support, break/fix support, code analysis, and defect fixes.
A slide titled “End-User Support” describes direct assistance for users of WebCenter applications and says it can cover part or all of a user base.
In a Q&A about support scope, the speaker conditions issue resolution on having VPN access.
evidence.quote: basic Enterprise support in a sense that we can fix or resolve issues on your behalf if we have VPN access

evidence.observation: The speaker describes engaging Oracle support on a customer's behalf conditional on access to the customer's Oracle CSI.
evidence.quote: If granted access to your Oracle CSI when necessary such in the case of defects we will engage Oracle support on your behalf
